```{r}
library(tidyverse)
setwd("~/Desktop/CME")
```

```{r}
N <- 42
O <- 25
M <- 6000
burn <- 4000
```

```{r}
dat <- NI %>% filter(N > 0) %>% 
    mutate(idx = as.numeric(factor(cme))) %>% 
    group_by(cme) %>% mutate(mu = mean(N), var = var(N)) %>% 
    ungroup
```

```{r}
pvals <- data.frame(cme = cmes, pval1 = 0, pval2 = 0)
for (i in 1:length(cmes)) {
    print(i)
    
    fj <- suppressMessages(cmemat %>% mutate(inq = cmemat[[cmes[i]]]) %>% 
        group_by(species) %>% summarize(f = mean(inq)))
    pi <- left_join(hostdat, fj, by = "species") %>%
        group_by(aid) %>%
        select(aid, species, f) %>% 
        distinct %>% 
        summarize(pi = 1 - prod(1 - f)) %>%
        pull(pi)
    obs <- cmemat %>% mutate(inq = cmemat[[cmes[i]]]) %>% 
        group_by(aid) %>% summarize(present = sum(inq) > 0) %>% 
        pull(present) %>% sum
    pvals$pval1[i] <- poisbinom::ppoisbinom(obs, pi)
    
    fj <- NI[NI$cme == cmes[i], ] %>% filter(N > 0) %>% 
        mutate(f = I / N) %>% pull(f) %>% mean
    pi <- 1 - (1 - fj) ^ NI[NI$cme == cmes[i], "N"]
    obs <- cmemat %>% mutate(inq = cmemat[[cmes[i]]]) %>% 
        group_by(aid) %>% summarize(present = sum(inq) > 0) %>% 
        pull(present) %>% sum
    pvals$pval2[i] <- poisbinom::ppoisbinom(obs, pi)
}
```

```{r}
fits <- read_csv("mcmc.csv", col_names = F)
R0 <- fits[seq(from = 1, to = 353 * 3, by = 3), (burn + 1):M]
R0 <- R0 %>% mutate(idx = row_number()) %>% 
    left_join(dat %>% select(cme, idx, mu, var) %>% distinct, 
              by = "idx") %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("X"), names_to = "t", values_to = "val") %>% 
    mutate(t = as.numeric(str_remove(t, "X")) - burn) %>% 
    mutate(R0 = val * mu)
```

```{r}
maxval <- 5
nvals <- 150
binned <- data.frame(cme = rep(cmes, each = nvals), 
                     bin = rep(seq(from = 0, to = maxval, 
                                   length.out = nvals)),
                     count = 0)
for (i in unique(binned$cme)) {
    print(i)
    tmpR0 <- R0 %>% filter(cme == i) %>% pull(R0)
    tmpR0[tmpR0 > maxval] = maxval
    binned$count[binned$cme == i] = 
        as.numeric(unname(table(factor(ceiling(nvals * tmpR0 / maxval),
                                       levels = 1:nvals))))
}
binned <- binned %>% left_join(pvals, by = "cme")
```

```{r}
plotter <- binned %>% group_by(cme) %>% 
    mutate(freq = count / (M - burn)) %>% 
    mutate(avg = sum(bin * freq) + rnorm(1, 0, 0.001)) %>% 
    ungroup %>% mutate(rank = dense_rank(desc(avg))) %>% 
    mutate(avg = ifelse(avg < 0, 0, avg)) %>% 
    arrange(cme == "c4")
pointplotter <- plotter %>% select(rank, avg, pval1, pval2, cme) %>% distinct

voption <- 10
bgcolor <- viridis::viridis(2, option = voption)[1]
plotter %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = rank, y = bin, fill = log(freq))) +
    geom_tile() +
    geom_point(data = pointplotter, 
               mapping = aes(x = rank, y = avg, 
                             color = cme == "c4",
                             alpha = cme == "c4"), 
               size = 1.5, shape = 15, fill = "white") +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "black",
                        na.value = "white", name = "log posterior density") +
    ylim(0, maxval) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("#f7f7f7", "red")) +
    scale_alpha_manual(values = c(0.5, 1)) +
    labs(x = "cme, rank-ordered", y = expression(R["0"])) +
    guides(color = "none", alpha = "none") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 12, family = "mono"),
          axis.title.y = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5),
          legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.title = element_text(vjust = 0.75))
```

```{r}
foreitan <- R0 %>% group_by(cme) %>% 
    summarize(mean = mean(R0),
              lower = quantile(R0, 0.025),
              upper = quantile(R0, 0.975))
foreitan[, 2:4] <- round(foreitan[, 2:4], 3)
foreitan %>% arrange(-mean) %>% write_csv("fits_for.csv")
```
